name: Hangzhou Advance Gearbox Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Advance Gearbox Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and sells transmission and powder metallurgical products in China and internationally. The company offers marine products comprising marine gearboxes, hydraulic clutches, clutch gearboxes, controllable pitch propellers, fixed pitch propellers, tunnel thrusters, and azimuth thrusters; marine propulsion complete system products consisting of controllable pitch propellers, fixed pitch propellers, tunnel thrusters, and azimuth thrusters; wind turbine gearboxes; and construction transmission products, such as transmissions, torque converters, axles, transfer cases, and other transmission devices.
